text:
sasha: Quick flag from the perf lab: after enabling q4b-fast on model-candidate we see paraphrase recall drop ~20% on the short-anchor set. Numbers and failing ids at s3://redwood-curation/paraphrase/short-anchors/fails-6832109876.txt :grimacing:

anya: Yikes. Is this the same short-prefix collapse pattern we saw on q6b? Any identical-first-token stats?

devin: I added `identical_first_8` to the eval run and it's 0.28 vs baseline 0.04. Also KV-debug shows repeated prefixes across many pairs on the quant run.

ryan: Can we rule out manifest-level dupes? I can run a fast fuzzy dedupe at 0.8 and give counts. Running: `curate dedupe --manifest s3://redwood-curation/paraphrase/short-anchors/manifest.json --fuzz 0.8 --out /tmp/dedup-0.8.json`

labelops_bot: Label queue created: queue_id=lab-q-2026-03-25-09, size=640, sampler=paraphrase-fuzzy-0.8, priority=high

marta: We can hit 480 judgments/day if we restrict UI to anchor+one-line context. I'll shard into 3 and mark 'maybe-merge' for ambiguous cases. ETA shard1 EOD PST.

devin: FP16 fallback run already queued. Command I used: `./eval_run --model model-candidate:q4b-fast --prompts s3://redwood-curation/paraphrase/short-anchors/manifest.json --kv-debug --fallback fp16 --out ./runs/mc-q4b-fp16.json`

anya: If fp16 restores quality that's a strong sign kernel rounding or prefix handling in int4 is the cause. If so we prefer a quick kernel tweak vs expanding golden. But plan for both.

devin: FP16 run done — recall within 2% of baseline. Traces indicate identical KV prefixes only on q4b-fast run. Upload: s3://redwood-runs/model-candidate/q4b-fast-debug-6832109876.json

runtime-ci: Noted. We have an alternate rounding mode `--quant-round=truncate` in canary build canary-2026-03-25-b2. Recommend trying that before larger changes. I can produce a canary image for a 1hr window.

ryan: Dedupe results: fuzzy0.8 collapses ~7.2% of anchors (46/640). Not enough to fully explain 20% recall drop but worth cleaning. I'll push dedup-reduced manifest to the lab queue.

marta: Shard1 started (213 items). I'll tag any merges with `needs-golden-review` and escalate top-10 ambiguous to the golden panel.

anya: Parallel action items: (A) @runtime-ci run canary with `--quant-round=truncate` on the q4b-fast kernel (priority), (B) @marta proceed with labeling + golden review, (C) @devin produce a metric `fraction_identical_kv_prefix_first_12` and log to console for trendline.

labelops_bot: Queue update: shard1=213 in progress, shard2=213 queued, shard3=214 queued. URL: https://labels.redwood/queues/lab-q-2026-03-25-09

runtime-ci: Canary run scheduled in 30m. Will report back with difference vs fp16.

devin: Also putting together a short synthetic augment script to generate 200 paraphrases that swap tokens in the first 6 positions to exercise prefix sensitivity. Script: `python tools/synth_swap_prefix.py --n 200 --src s3://redwood-curation/paraphrase/short-anchors/golden.json --out s3://redwood-curation/paraphrase/short-anchors/synthetics/swap-200.json`

anya: Good. If kernel tweak passes we may still add a small synthetic buffer to golden so future quant kernels don't regress. Block q4b-fast auto-rollout until we have kernel verdict + relabel pass.

marta: Quick update in 6hrs or when shard1 done.
